Tactical Stripe Camo Scallop Fight Shorts

Develop custom camo MMA shorts for your fightwear brand, academy or gym. This olive-and-charcoal reference combines curved scallop leg openings, a pin-dot mesh hem detail and a gathered drawcord waist for a movement-focused training collection.

  • Scallop side openings for your chosen mobility and coverage
  • Mesh lower-hem detail and bound edges
  • Elastic drawcord waistband with multi-row stitching
  • Private-label artwork, colors, labels and packaging

Construction details for your custom fight shorts

Deep scallop leg openings

Curved side cutaways shape the leg opening. Approve slit depth, binding, seam finish and stress-point reinforcement on a physical sample before production.

Pin-dot mesh hem detail

The lower hem includes a visible mesh detail. Select the mesh and placement to match your ventilation, coverage and durability requirements.

Drawcord elastic waistband

Multi-row stitching and a drawcord define the gathered waist. Check relaxed and stretched waist measurements, cord finish and movement fit during sampling.

Custom camo MMA shorts: buyer questions

Can you manufacture custom camo MMA shorts with our branding?

Yes. TONTON develops OEM/ODM fight shorts for brands, academies and gyms. Submit your authorized logo, camo artwork, colors, labels and packaging brief, then approve placement and the physical sample.

What makes scallop fight shorts different from straight-leg shorts?

Scallop shorts have curved leg openings and side cutaways. Specify the opening depth and hem finish to suit your movement and coverage requirements, then check the fit through kicking, squatting and grappling movements.

Can the mesh hem and drawcord waistband be customized?

Discuss mesh placement, binding, waistband width, elastic tension and drawcord construction with the development team. Confirm these details and stress-point reinforcement on your approved sample.

What fabric composition and GSM are available?

Select a swatch against your required composition, GSM, stretch, opacity and drying performance. Exact fiber percentages and weight for this reference are confirmed during quotation and sampling; performance claims require agreed testing.

What is the MOQ and how do we get a quotation?

MOQ, sample cost and production lead time depend on the selected fabric, artwork, colors, sizes and branding. Send your estimated quantity, size allocation, logo or reference, delivery country and target date for a project-specific quote.

Can we develop a matching rash guard and shorts set?

Yes. Request coordinated camo artwork and branding across a rash guard and shorts project. The product shown here is the shorts reference; confirm both garments separately in your quotation.
